# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Early-morning opening range bias combined with VWAP mean-reversion and a bullish EMA ribbon creates a high-probability long pullback setup. The edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend VWAP as a fair value anchor during low-volatility chop, and the opening range establishes intraday sentiment that price tends to revisit before extending.

## Mechanism

At 09:45 EST, compute the 15-minute opening range (09:30-09:45) high and low. At 10:30 EST, require: price above VWAP, EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon), and 15-minute volume > 1.5× its 20-bar average. Enter long on the first 15-minute bar closing above VWAP after touching it (pullback to VWAP). Exit: stop at opening-range low (chart-stop), take profit at 1.5R or trail using 10% ATR chandelier after 1R is reached. Only trade between 09:45-11:30 EST when VIX < 20 and ADX(14) < 20.

2. **Sample bias:** Hypothesis formed from intraday price action observation; no historical sample used yet. High overfit risk until Stage-1 backtest validates on >1 year of 5m SPY data.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).

6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days exceed 20% of P&L.
